name: flip
description: Turn one-off agent research into source-grounded notebooks another agent can continue, challenge, and publish from.

interface.longDescription: Capture the material research relies on, keep evidence and claims at honest states, pursue follow-on questions, and carry an attributed record across agent handoffs.
defaultPrompt: Use Flip for this investigation and leave a notebook another agent can inspect and continue.
Create a Flip pursuit notebook for this research question.
Capture and grade the sources this work relies on.
Audit this notebook's load-bearing claims and prepare a cold-start handoff.
Turn this repeated research process into a reusable Flip workflow or plugin.
